V. 52.
Every ſcribe inſtructed unto the kingdom of heaven—That is, every duly-prepared Preacher of the Goſpel, has a Treaſure of divine Knowledge, out of which he is able to bring forth all Sorts of Inſtructions. The Word Treaſure ſignifies any Collection of This whatſoever, and the Places where ſuch Collections are k•••.
